name: projeto-promotor
description: Sistema completo de acompanhamento operacional de promotores de vendas

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @promotor/config && npm run build -w @promotor/types && npm run build -w @promotor/ui
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev -w @promotor/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @promotor/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @promotor/web
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:packages && npm run start -w @promotor/mobile
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @promotor/config && npm run lint -w @promotor/types && npm run lint -w @promotor/ui && npm run lint -w @promotor/api && npm run lint -w @promotor/web && npm run lint -w @promotor/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @promotor/config && npm run typecheck -w @promotor/types && npm run typecheck -w @promotor/ui && npm run typecheck -w @promotor/api && npm run typecheck -w @promotor/web && npm run typecheck -w @promotor/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test -w @promotor/config && npm run test -w @promotor/types && npm run test -w @promotor/ui && npm run test -w @promotor/api && npm run test -w @promotor/web && npm run test -w @promotor/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @promotor/api && npm run build -w @promotor/web && npm run build -w @promotor/mobile
scripts.format: npm run format -w @promotor/config && npm run format -w @promotor/types && npm run format -w @promotor/ui && npm run format -w @promotor/api && npm run format -w @promotor/web && npm run format -w @promotor/mobile
